title: Energy Stores & Transfers - Application
welcome_lead: Trace energy through real machines and devices.
meta_desc: KS3 Physics: applying stores and transfers to everyday machines.
final_note: You can trace energy through any device now - awesome!

concepts.def: Kinetic, gravitational, elastic, thermal, chemical, etc.
Energy moved between stores mechanically, electrically, by heating or radiation.
Energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transferred.
Useful energy out ÷ total energy in (always less than 100%).
Energy transferred when a force moves an object; W = Fd.
The rate of energy transfer (watts); P = E ÷ t.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Every machine has useful energy output (what we want) and wasted energy (often heat or sound).

A lamp: useful = light, wasted = heat.
A car engine: useful = motion, wasted = heat + sound.
A kettle: useful = heating water, wasted = sound + heat to room.

Wasted energy is dissipated - it spreads out and is hard to use again.

A pendulum is a great energy demo.

At the top: lots of gravitational, no kinetic.
At the bottom: lots of kinetic, no gravitational.
Halfway: a mix of both.

Energy swaps from gravitational to kinetic and back, transferred mechanically.

A roller coaster shows everything:

1. Motor lifts cart (electrical -> gravitational).
2. Cart drops (gravitational -> kinetic).
3. Friction with rails (kinetic -> thermal + sound).
4. Brakes at the end (kinetic -> thermal).

Total energy stays the same overall - just keeps changing form.

mcqs.q: A book on a high shelf has lots of energy in its:
options: kinetic store
gravitational store
chemical store
sound store

mcqs.q: Petrol stores energy in which form?
options: thermal
kinetic
chemical
gravitational

mcqs.q: If a car has negative acceleration, what does that necessarily mean?
options: Only if it speeds up or slows down on the circle.
Its acceleration is in the negative direction (often opposite to the chosen positive direction); it may be slowing down or speeding up in reverse.
Negative acceleration means the car is moving backwards.
Negative acceleration always means the car is slowing down.

mcqs.q: An object moves in a circle at constant speed. Is it accelerating?
options: Only if it speeds up or slows down on the circle.
Negative acceleration means the car is moving backwards.
No — constant speed means no acceleration.
Yes — its direction is constantly changing, so its velocity changes; centripetal acceleration points toward the centre of the circle.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Gravitational store”?
options: Energy in an object held high up; bigger if mass or height is bigger.
Energy in a moving object; faster and heavier objects have more.
Where energy is held until transferred — like kinetic, gravitational, chemical, thermal.
Energy in food, fuel and batteries; released by reactions.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Energy store”?
options: Energy in a moving object; faster and heavier objects have more.
Energy can't be made or destroyed, only transferred from store to store.
Energy in an object held high up; bigger if mass or height is bigger.
Where energy is held until transferred — like kinetic, gravitational, chemical, thermal.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Thermal store”?
options: Where energy is held until transferred — like kinetic, gravitational, chemical, thermal.
Energy in a moving object; faster and heavier objects have more.
Energy can't be made or destroyed, only transferred from store to store.
Energy in hotter objects; transferred when in contact with cooler ones.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Chemical store”?

Energy in food, fuel and batteries; released by reactions.

options: Energy in an object held high up; bigger if mass or height is bigger.
